content.text:
The site looks right again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass against the approved screenshots. Three values in `site/css/styles.css` had been changed, and I restored each one:

- **`.d-flex`** (line 7027) was `display: none`, which hid the cart button and the quantity and "Add to cart" row. It is now `display: flex`.
- **`.lead`** (line 490) had `font-size: 1.875rem`, which made the product description oversized. It is now `1.25rem`.
- **`.form-control`** (line 1999) had `line-height: 2.25`, which made the quantity input and its row too tall. It is now `1.5`.

I haven't committed anything. The repo only has one commit, so I worked out the original values from the screenshot diffs and Bootstrap's defaults.
